reports.title: Joanna Chamberlain: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: there appears to be a local and national gap in the provision of safe and supportive spaces, where clinical help and care can be given to mental health patients who may not be in immediate crisis yet who would benefit from more support than can be given by home treatment teams
concerns.hazard: lack of safe supportive spaces for mental health patients

concerns.quote: there is a potential need for clearer national guidance on, direction to and protocols for clinicians to proactively seek and include the views and input of family members, or others (e.g. GP), reinforcing the triangle of care
concerns.hazard: absence of clear national guidance for clinicians to involve family and GP in care plans

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of national guidance for involving families in the care of mental health patients. They call for clearer national direction to ensure family input is sought and used.
